reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing exported getScheduledAmount, the same helper the schedules table, mobile list and balance already use for missing, single and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: No amount rule is restated; the single line delegates the whole decision to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's external schedule shape is built.

scope.why: One type field, one mapping line, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Trivial to own and stays in sync with the app's rule; the read-only field sits in the shared create/update type as an optional property marked ignored by comment rather than a separate read type.
